findings.status: observed missing mainnet headers-sync configuration; required regression remains selected
findings.observation: PoCX mainnet omits m_headers_sync_params initialization because the upstream initialization is inside the Bitcoin-only branch. HeadersSyncParams defaults commitment_period to zero. Inherited headers_sync_state consumes an invalid 1..0 range; the native HeadersSyncState constructor requires commitment_period > 0. Peer processing can construct this state using actual network parameters for low-work sync.
findings.scope: Verified mainnet configuration and fuzz constructor precondition failure; network reachability/exploit not established. Default minimum chain work zero may avoid early-chain entry, but this does not provide a valid nonzero period for future/overridden thresholds.
findings.blocked_criterion: M4 applicable headers-sync fuzz parity and M3 native P2P headers-sync configuration coverage.
findings.resolution: Preserve both required configuration-dependent failures; supplemental pocx_headers_sync_state uses explicit pinned upstream test bounds for independent state-machine coverage. Do not silently substitute those bounds into the required network-configured target. Production settings unchanged.

findings.status: resolved: verified in fresh complete functional matrix in both global transports
findings.observation: Original copier always reads80-byte headers and hashes them directly. Native286-byte headers need zeroed signature for block IDs, so all native blocks appear unknown and bootstrap import cannot complete.
findings.resolution: Explicit block_format=pocx uses286-byte headers and zero-signature block hashes, copying original signed bytes unchanged. Default bitcoin behavior retained. Separate native functional adapter keeps original100-block import and equality assertions.
